usage: om vpn [-h] [--json] [--no-apply] [{list,trust,untrust,allow,disallow,devices}] [name]

positional arguments:
  {list,trust,untrust,allow,disallow,devices}
                        list (default), trust, untrust, allow, disallow or devices
  name                  trust/untrust: interface (wg0, zt…) or address; allow/disallow: device
                        address, range or VPN name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Machine-readable output (list)
  --no-apply            allow/disallow: leave the host firewall alone (the VPN's private tier
                        closes until `om firewall apply`)
